title: The Whistleblower
description: You saw something, said something, and paid for it. History will be kinder to you than your bank ever was.

title: Carbon Unicorn
description: Rich, famous and light on the planet: the rarest creature in the business world. Investors still don't believe you exist.

title: Yacht Tycoon
description: You won the game everyone told you to play, and then bought a boat bigger than your school's amphitheatre. The ocean noticed.

title: Panopticon Architect
description: Your code kept 'people' safe. You never quite asked which people, and the dashboards never told you.

title: Fossil Baron
description: You powered progress, as the brochure said, and the progress came with a very large receipt.

title: Startup Legend
description: A whiteboard, a domain name, a terrible first pitch, and then an exit. AIDAMS still tells the story at the asso fair.

title: No Comment
description: Your lawyers were excellent. Your reputation was not. A lifetime of statements with the word 'regrettable' in them.

title: Burnt-out Consultant
description: Fifty-five-hour weeks, three countries a week, one car park where it all stopped. You climbed fast. Your body sent the bill.

title: Doomscroll Royalty
description: Millions knew your face, few knew you. You were always one post away from happy, for decades.

title: Off-Grid Sage
description: Tomatoes, birdsong and a footprint so small the planet barely felt you. Your old classmates still don't understand, and envy you.

title: Frugal Researcher
description: Small models, honest papers, cheap coffee. You made the field a little smarter and a lot more careful.

title: Treaty Whisperer
description: Bracketed paragraphs, night trains to Geneva, and one annex that quietly changed how the world builds AI.

title: Jet-Set Nomad
description: Every continent, every lounge, every sunset. If everyone lived like you, the sunsets would be spectacular and very hot.

title: Golden Handcuffs
description: The salary was perfect, the bonus generous, the Sundays long and grey. You were very good at a life you didn't love.

title: Reinvented
description: An algorithm took your job around forty. You took the rest of your life back. Not bad for a cardboard box.

title: Quiet Hero
description: No headlines, no keynotes. Just thousands of people whose lives went a little better because you were there.

title: PM's Successor
description: Front row at 8AM in Year 1, front of the room at 8AM decades later. PM would be proud. PM is proud.

title: Analog Soul
description: You kept your phone on a leash and your eyes on people. Your screen time report was a short read for sixty years.

title: The Late Convert
description: Half a life chasing the next title, half a life chasing the next good deed. The second half wrote the better story.

title: Failed Up
description: Your startup died, beautifully. You learned more in three years than in the previous twenty, and dined out on it forever.

title: Beloved Elder
description: Your funeral was standing room only, and the stories were funny. That's the whole point, really.

title: Corporate Lifer
description: One badge, one parking spot, twenty years of quarterly reviews. Solid, safe, slightly beige. Someone has to.

title: Ordinary Legend
description: No single headline, just a whole life: good choices, bad ones, and a few great 3AM conversations. Which is what most legends are made of.
